title: A Border for the Ghost
author: A. M. Whitlock
blurb: Marguerite Thornbury, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
